from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, pathlib, json
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/runs/electronics_in_bin'); OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

def connect(): return Robot()
def pose_row(p,q,g=0.0): return [*p,*q,float(g)]
def save_res(res,name):
 d=OUT/name; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); res.save(str(d))
 print('result',name,'done=',res.meta.get('done'),'reason=',res.meta.get('reason'),'plan=',res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped=',res.meta.get('clipped'),'steps=',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'))
 print('last tcp',res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[None]*15)[8:15])
 return res
if __name__=='__main__':
 r=connect(); s=r.spec(); print('connected; time_left',r.status().get('time_left_s'))
 o=r.get_obs(depth=True,video='none')
 q0=[0.0,-0.7071068,0.7071068,0.0]; qx=[0.0,1.0,0.0,0.0]
